physicalNotes: Radius 1.006 +/- 0.031 solar radii from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-19 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract): 699,874 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.965 +/- 0.091 solar masses from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-19 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5616 +/- 66 K from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-19 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
